presentation.name: Assess a dataset for missing values, zeros, duplicates and outliers
presentation.summary: Judges which columns of a dataset can be trusted before anyone builds a chart or a metric.
benefits: Separates missing values from placeholders, so a zero used as unknown is not counted as a real zero
Names which duplicate claim failed: an exact row, the business key, or fan-out from a join
Keeps a statistical outlier as a candidate and lists domain-impossible values on their own
Reports a rate only when it was computed, and marks the rest insufficient evidence
